description: The bio page's Shop the post grid: published posts (newest first) and any post with products attached, each with its products, how often its sheet was opened and each product tapped, whether it's on the grid now (why not, if it isn't), and story_url for a story's link sticker. The grid shows up to 24 posts, and See all opens up to 96. Instagram posts put up outside Chockstone come too (synced: true) once the insights sync has copied their picture, every few hours while the bio page exists. The order is the grid's: pinned first, then newest first, except tiles moved by hand (shop_posts_arrange). Each post carries suggested products to offer; none are attached until post_links_set.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
